# Input

> **Kind:** context · **Registry:** host · **Folder:** [`src/view/components/`](../folders/src-view-components.md)
> **Source:** [`src/view/components/input.h`](../../../src/view/components/input.h)

## Summary

Per-frame keyboard, mouse and window state of the desktop window.

## Description

Host context variable emplaced by InputSys's constructor (so it exists as soon as the scene's host systems are built). InputSys rewrites it every frame from SDL events: action bits in `on` follow key down/up (they stay set while the key is held), click flags and wheel/motion deltas are reset at the start of InputSys::tick and are therefore valid for one frame. UISys consumes `text` and masks clicks/downs captured by ImGui. Several systems consume one-shot action bits by clearing them: TimeSys clears PAUSE, PlayerControlSys clears VR_RIG, Game::start clears EXIT. DebugMenuSys sets VR_RIG from a button. Not registered with the component registry; Game::start requires it (reg.ctx().get<Input>() after init), so every rendered scene must list the Input system.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | `std::optional<std::array<char, SDL_TEXTINPUTEVENT_TEXT_SIZE>>` | std::nullopt | Last SDL_TEXTINPUT of the frame; consumed (reset) by UISys. |
| `on` | `std::bitset<Action::END_ENUM>` | all false | Action bits. Mapped keys: W FORWARD, S BACKWARD, A LEFT, D RIGHT, P PAUSE, Space UP, LCtrl DOWN, LShift SPRINT, R VR_RIG, M MENU, K DEBUG, Backspace BACKSPACE, Left ROTATE_LEFT, Right ROTATE_RIGHT, Up ANGLE_UP, Down ANGLE_DOWN, Tab TAB. RESIZE set on window resize (never cleared by InputSys); EXIT set by SDL_QUIT or Escape. |
| `mousePos` | `glm::ivec2` | uninitialized | Mouse position in window pixels, updated only while focused. |
| `mouseWheel` | `glm::ivec2` | uninitialized (zeroed each tick) | Wheel of the last SDL_MOUSEWHEEL event this frame (not summed). |
| `mouseDelta` | `glm::ivec2` | uninitialized (zeroed each tick) | Sum of relative mouse motion this frame. |
| `screenSize` | `glm::ivec2` | uninitialized | SDL_GetWindowSize of the desktop window, each tick. |
| `mouseLeft / mouseRight / mouseMiddle` | `bool` | false | Raw button held state from SDL. |
| `leftDown / rightDown / middleDown` | `bool` | false | Button held state; UISys forces false while ImGui wants the mouse, else copies the raw state. |
| `leftClick / rightClick / middleClick` | `bool` | false | Button pressed this frame; UISys clears them while ImGui wants the mouse. |
| `focused` | `bool` | false | Window has keyboard focus (SDL focus gained/lost events). |
| `window_showing` | `bool` | true | False after minimize, true after restore. |

| System | Kind | Registry | Access | Phase | Details |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [BoxThrowerSys](../systems/BoxThrowerSys.md) | system | host | `read` | tick | leftClick (already cleared by UISys when ImGui wants the mouse). |
| [ClassicRender](../systems/ClassicRender.md) | service | host | `read` | prepare | find; window_showing == false skips acquiring the swapchain image (target inactive this frame). |
| [DebugMenuSys](../systems/DebugMenuSys.md) | system | host | `write` | tick | Button 'Move play area to camera (R)' sets on[VR_RIG] (handled by PlayerControlSys next frame or later in the same frame if it runs after). |
| [Game](../systems/Game.md) | service | host | `readwrite` | tick | Reads on[EXIT] after renderer->prepare() and clears it; stops the loop after the current iteration. |
| [InputSys](../systems/InputSys.md) | system | host | `write` +emplace_ctx | constructor | reg.ctx().emplace<Input>() in the constructor. |
| [InputSys](../systems/InputSys.md) | system | host | `readwrite` | tick | Resets leftClick/rightClick/middleClick, mouseWheel, mouseDelta; then per SDL event sets on[RESIZE], focused, window_showing, on[EXIT], mapped action bits, mouse button flags, mouseDelta (summed), mouseWheel (last event), text; then screenSize and, when focused, mousePos. |
| [PlayerControlSys](../systems/PlayerControlSys.md) | system | host | `readwrite` | tick | Reads rightDown, mouseDelta, mouseWheel, on[FORWARD/BACKWARD/LEFT/RIGHT/UP/DOWN/SPRINT/VR_RIG]; clears on[VR_RIG] when handling it. |
| [RollerPlayerSys](../systems/RollerPlayerSys.md) | system | host | `read` | tick | DesktopRoller: on[FORWARD/BACKWARD/LEFT/RIGHT/SPRINT]. |
| [TimeSys](../systems/TimeSys.md) | system | host | `readwrite` | tick | Reads on[PAUSE] and clears it; reads screenSize.x to pin the Time window to the top-right corner. |
| [UISys](../systems/UISys.md) | system | host | `readwrite` | tick | Reads mouseLeft/Right/Middle, text, on[BACKSPACE], on[TAB], focused, mousePos, screenSize into ImGuiIO; resets text to nullopt; after ImGui::NewFrame clears leftClick/rightClick/middleClick and leftDown/rightDown/middleDown if io.WantCaptureMouse, else copies mouseLeft/Right/Middle into leftDown/rightDown/middleDown. |

## Side effects per system

- **[ClassicRender](../systems/ClassicRender.md)**
  - vkAcquireNextImageKHR (blocks until an image is available)
- **[InputSys](../systems/InputSys.md)**
  - drains the SDL event queue (SDL_PollEvent)
  - SDL_GetWindowSize, SDL_GetMouseState
- **[PlayerControlSys](../systems/PlayerControlSys.md)**
  - SDL_SetRelativeMouseMode every tick (on while the right button is down)
- **[UISys](../systems/UISys.md)**
  - ImGui::NewFrame
  - writes ImGuiIO (MouseDown, MousePos, DisplaySize, DeltaTime, key and text events)
